## Checklist
- [ ] Ensure that `devDependencies` and other `dependencies` are properly distinguished in `package.json`.
- [ ] Use [conventional commit messages](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) for all commits.
- [ ] Create / Update [JSDoc](https://jsdoc.app/) comments for all functions and methods.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat` - New feature
- [ ] `fix` - Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` - Code refactoring
- [ ] `chore` - Maintenance/config changes
- [ ] `docs` - Documentation
